31147-a-new-bat-myotis-from-mexico.title: A New Bat (Myotis) From Mexico
31147-a-new-bat-myotis-from-mexico.creator: Unknown
31147-a-new-bat-myotis-from-mexico.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Comparisons._--Among named kinds of _Myotis_, _M. elegans_ shows  most resemblance to the species _M. Differences from the latter include shorter tail and  ear, more golden color on underparts, pale (not blackish) lips,  ears and flight membranes, more slender tragus, shorter skull,  posterior border of P4 (in occlusal view) more deeply notched, and  longitudinal dorsal profile of skull higher in frontal and  lambdoidal regions.

6743-colonel-carter-of-cartersville.title: Colonel Carter Of Cartersville
6743-colonel-carter-of-cartersville.creator: Unknown
6743-colonel-carter-of-cartersville.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The street entrance to this curious abode is marked by a swinging wooden gate opening into a narrow tunnel which dodges under the front house. It is an uncanny sort of passageway, mouldy and wet from a long-neglected leak overhead, and is lighted at night by a rusty lantern with dingy glass sides.

arxiv-2104-13559.title: AraStance: A Multi-Country and Multi-Domain Dataset of Arabic Stance Detection for Fact Checking
arxiv-2104-13559.creator: Tariq Alhindi, Amal Alabdulkarim, Ali Alshehri, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed, and Preslav Nakov
arxiv-2104-13559.description: Abstract With the continuing spread of misinformation and disinformation online, it is of increasing importance to develop combating mechanisms at scale in the form of automated systems that support multiple languages. One task of interest is claim veracity prediction, which can be addressed using stance detection with respect to relevant documents retrieved online.

arxiv-2109-01988.title: C n C_{n} -symmetric higher-order topological crystalline insulators in atomically thin transition-metal dichalcogenides
arxiv-2109-01988.creator: Shifeng Qian, Gui-Bin Liu, Cheng-Cheng Liu, Yugui Yao
arxiv-2109-01988.description: Abstract Based on first-principles calculations and symmetry analysis, we predict atomically thin ( 1 − N 1-N layers) 2H group-VIB TMDs M ​ X 2 MX_{2} ( M M = Mo, W; X X = S, Se, Te) are large-gap higher-order topological crystalline insulators protected by C 3 C_{3} rotation symmetry.

arxiv-2211-15750.title: Log-enhanced discretization errors in integrated correlation functions
arxiv-2211-15750.description: Abstract Integrated time-slice correlation functions G ⁡ ( t ) G(t) with weights K ⁡ ( t ) K(t) appear, e.g., in the moments method to determine α s \alpha_{s} from heavy quark correlators, in the muon g-2 determination or in the determination of smoothed spectral functions.

arxiv-2301-07377.title: Nanophotonics for pair production
arxiv-2301-07377.creator: Valerio Di Giulio, F. Javier García de Abajo
arxiv-2301-07377.description: Abstract The transformation of electromagnetic energy into matter represents a fascinating prediction of relativistic quantum electrodynamics that is paradigmatically exemplified by the creation of electron-positron pairs out of light. However, this phenomenon has a very low probability, so positron sources rely instead on beta decay, which demands elaborate monochromatization and trapping schemes to achieve high-quality beams.

arxiv-2401-00942.title: The Influence of Biomedical Research on Future Business Funding: Analyzing Scientific Impact and Content in Industrial Investments
arxiv-2401-00942.creator: Reza Khanmohammadi, Simerjot Kaur, Charese H. Smiley, Tuka Alhanai, Ivan Brugere, Armineh Nourbakhsh, Mohammad M. Ghassemi
arxiv-2401-00942.description: Abstract This paper investigates the relationship between scientific innovation in biomedical sciences and its impact on industrial activities, focusing on how the historical impact and content of scientific papers influenced future funding and innovation grant application content for small businesses.

arxiv-2506-21224.title: Metal Polluted White Dwarfs with 21 µm IR excesses from JWST/MIRI: Planets or Dust?
arxiv-2506-21224.creator: John H. Debes, Sabrina Poulsen, Ashley Messier, Susan E. Mullally, Katherine Thibault, Loïc Albert, Misty Cracraft, Érika Le Bourdais, Patrick Dufour, Tom Barclay, J. J. Hermes, Mukremin Kilic, David Lafrenière, Fergal Mullally, William Reach, Elisa Quintana
arxiv-2506-21224.description: Abstract White dwarfs with metal pollution are caused by the accretion of rocky dust from tidally disrupted minor bodies and are signposts for planetary systems. These minor bodies are perturbed by planets that have survived post-main sequence evolution. Open questions exist as to the typical mass of the perturbers and the specific planetary architectures that cause metal pollution.

arxiv-2509-15992.title: A stochastic heat engine driven using a nonlinear protocol
arxiv-2509-15992.creator: Amrutayani Panda, Biswajit Das, Shuvojit Paul, Arnab Saha, Ayan Banerjee
arxiv-2509-15992.description: Abstract A colloidal particle confined in a time-dependent optical trap can function as a microscopic heat engine, with optimization strategies playing a crucial role in enhancing its performance. In this study, we numerically investigate a Stirling heat engine operating in both passive and active environments using a protocol inspired by the Engineered Swift Equilibration (ESE) method.

arxiv-2510-01546.title: Growing Visual Generative Capacity for Pre-Trained MLLMs
arxiv-2510-01546.creator: Hanyu Wang, Jiaming Han, Ziyan Yang, Qi Zhao, Shanchuan Lin, Xiangyu Yue, Abhinav Shrivastava, Zhenheng Yang, Hao Chen
arxiv-2510-01546.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hanyu Wang, Jiaming Han, Ziyan Yang, Qi Zhao, Shanchuan Lin, Xiangyu Yue, Abhinav Shrivastava, Zhenheng Yang, Hao Chen. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend the success of language models to visual understanding, and recent efforts have sought to build unified MLLMs that support both understanding and generation.

arxiv-2510-07452.title: Patch : Mitigating PII Leakage in Language Models with P rivacy- A ware T argeted C ircuit Patc H ing
arxiv-2510-07452.creator: Anthony Hughes, Vasisht Duddu, N. Asokan, Nikolaos Aletras, Ning Ma
arxiv-2510-07452.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anthony Hughes, Vasisht Duddu, N. Asokan, Nikolaos Aletras, Ning Ma. Language models (LMs) may memorize personally identifiable information (PII) from training data, enabling adversaries to extract it during inference. Existing defense mechanisms such as differential privacy (DP) reduce this leakage, but incur large drops in utility. Based on a comprehensive study using circuit discovery to identify the computational circuits responsible PII leakage in LMs, We hypothesize that specific PII leakage circuits in LMs should be responsible for this behavior.

arxiv-2510-17912.title: Space charge and ion transport in aerosol neutralization: Toward a concentration-dependent alternative to the N i ​ t N_{i}t product
arxiv-2510-17912.creator: Kunal. Ghosh a,* , Gargi Sengupta b , Rukhsar Parveen c , Y. S. Mayya c
arxiv-2510-17912.description: Abstract In this study, we quantify how charged particle concentration affects the neutralization rate of aerosol particles, focusing on the role of ion dynamics shaped by internal electric fields arising from net space charge. Conventional neutralizer performance is typically evaluated using the N i ​ t N_{i}t product, which assumes quasi-neutral conditions and neglects electric fields from small charge imbalances.

pmc-10598655.title: Central-to-peripheral blood pressure amplification: role of the recording site, technology, analysis approach, and calibration scheme in invasive and non-invasive data agreement
pmc-10598655.creator: Yanina Zócalo, Daniel Bia, Ramiro Sánchez, Gustavo Lev, Oscar Mendiz, Agustín Ramirez, Edmundo I. Cabrera-Fischer
pmc-10598655.description: BackgroundSystolic blood pressure amplification (SBPA) and pulse pressure amplification (PPA) can independently predict cardiovascular damage and mortality. A wide range of methods are used for the non-invasive estimation of SBPA and PPA. The most accurate non-invasive method for obtaining SBPA and/or PPA remains unknown.

pmc-10648332.title: Impact of gasless vNOTES vs. traditional vNOTES on hemodynamic profiles and outcomes in patients with benign gynecological disease: study protocol of a randomized controlled trial
pmc-10648332.creator: Kai Liu, Qinghua Huang, Yanjun Wang, Qianqian Zhang, Dan Feng, Zhaolin Gong, Jiaojiao Chen, Li He, Yu Cui, Yonghong Lin
pmc-10648332.description: BackgroundLiterature regarding the advantages of gasless vNOTES is insufficient. The aim of our study is to compare gasless vNOTES vs. traditional vNOTES on hemodynamic profiles and outcomes in patients with benign gynecological disease. We hypothesize that compared with those in the traditional vNOTES group, hemodynamic profiles will be changed less during gasless vNOTES, while safety can be promised.

pmc-10655118.title: Guest Encapsulation Alters the Thermodynamic Landscape of a Coordination Host
pmc-10655118.creator: Kuntrapakam Hema, Angela B. Grommet, Michał J. Białek, Jinhua Wang, Laura Schneider, Christoph Drechsler, Oksana Yanshyna, Yael Diskin-Posner, Guido H. Clever, Rafal Klajn
pmc-10655118.description: The architecture of self-assembled host molecules can profoundly affect the properties of the encapsulated guests. For example, a rigid cage with small windows can efficiently protect its contents from the environment; in contrast, tube-shaped, flexible hosts with large openings and an easily accessible cavity are ideally suited for catalysis.

pmc-11654448.title: Darolutamide in Combination With Androgen-Deprivation Therapy in Patients With Metastatic Hormone-Sensitive Prostate Cancer From the Phase III ARANOTE Trial
pmc-11654448.creator: Fred Saad, Egils Vjaters, Neal Shore, David Olmos, Nianzeng Xing, Andrea Juliana Pereira de Santana Gomes, Augusto Cesar de Andrade Mota, Pamela Salman, Mindaugas Jievaltas, Albertas Ulys, Maris Jakubovskis, Evgeny Kopyltsov, Weiqing Han, Liina Nevalaita, Isabella Testa, Marie-Aude Le Berre, Iris Ku
pmc-11654448.description: PURPOSEFor patients with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC), delaying progression to castration-resistant disease is important not only for overall survival (OS) but also for patients' quality of life. Darolutamide plus androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) with docetaxel improved OS versus ADT and docetaxel in patients with mHSPC. The ARANOTE trial evaluated darolutamide and ADT without chemotherapy in patients with mHSPC.

pmc-11662922.title: The Association Between the rs2200733 SNP and Atrial Fibrillation Among Arabs: A Study from Jordan
pmc-11662922.creator: Abdullah H Al-Kasasbeh, Omar F Khabour, Rowida Almomani, Muhannad Ababneh, Rashid Ibdah, Mohamad Ismail Jarrah, Sukaina I Rawashdeh, Abdelsamea Mohammed Seif
pmc-11662922.description: IntroductionAtrial fibrillation (AFib) is a common disorder featured by an irregular and fast heartbeat. The etiology of AFib is complex and involves genetic and environmental factors. The rs2200733 single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) is located in close proximity to the promoter of paired-like homeodomain transcription factor 2 (PITX2) which plays a role in heart development.

pmc-11715844.title: Retinal and brain imaging modalities for AD detection and monitoring
pmc-11715844.creator: Ralph N Martins, Purna Poudel, Kevin Taddei, Shaun Eslick, Shaun Frost, Eugene Hone
pmc-11715844.description: BackgroundAs an extension of the central nervous system (CNS), the retina shares many similarities with the brain and can manifest signs of various neurological diseases, including Alzheimer’s disease (AD). This study investigates the spectral features of the retina to develop a classification model for the differentiation of individuals with elevated brain amyloid levels.

pmc-11992410.title: The predictive value of neutrophil–lymphocyte ratio combined with the Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events score for inhospital adverse cardiovascular events in patients with acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction
pmc-11992410.creator: Caoyang Fang, Zhenfei Chen, Jing Zhang, Xiaoqin Jin, Mengsi Yang
pmc-11992410.description: Background:The research explores the predictive efficacy of the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) in conjunction with the Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events (GRACEs) score for inhospital major adverse cardiovascular events (MACEs) among acute ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) subjects with primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) history.

pmc-12512314.title: Does public indebtedness matter in the effect of public health expenditure on human longevity in Sub-Saharan Africa countries? Evidence from dynamic panel threshold regression
pmc-12512314.creator: Jacques Boundioa
pmc-12512314.description: The third Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) aims to enable everyone to live in good health and to promote the well-being of all. However, despite the various efforts made to achieve this goal, sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) is still characterised by low human longevity. To increase longevity, authors have stressed the importance of public spending on health.

pmc-12540753.title: Single-cell and bulk transcriptomics uncovers PRKD2-driven tumor stemness and progression in multiple myeloma
pmc-12540753.creator: Guihua Zhang, Shengya Cao, Chong Geng, Yueyue Sun, Jinge Xu, Chong Chen, Faan Miao, Huanxin Zhang, Yunxin Kong, Rongke Jiang, Kaige Liu, Jiaqian Qi, Zhenyu Li, Hong Liu
pmc-12540753.description: Multiple myeloma (MM) remains incurable, as most patients relapse or become refractory (RRMM), and the molecular nexus among clonal evolution, immune escape and therapy response remains unknown. Bulk RNA-seq from 24 MM to 6 matched marrows (subset of 132) plus single-cell datasets were analysed by differential expression, pseudotime, WGCNA, enrichment, immune deconvolution and GDSC drug screens.

pmc-12588339.title: Exploring the Lived Experiences of Adults With Sickle Cell Disease in Nigeria Using van Manen's Phenomenological Approach
pmc-12588339.creator: Florence Idowu Michael, Chinomso Nwozichi, Omolabake Salako, Mosidat Oshodi‐Bakare, Elizabeth Olaogun, Josiah Nang‐Bayi
pmc-12588339.description: PurposeThis study explores the lived experiences of adults with sickle cell disease (SCD) in Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria, providing insights into their struggles and coping mechanisms.DesignA qualitative phenomenological study was conducted to gain a deeper understanding of the lived experiences of adults with SCD.MethodsThis study employed a phenomenological approach to explore the lived experiences of adults with SCD.

pmc-12634315.title: PRF‐Assisted Crestal Sinus Floor Elevation With Bone Tap Drills in the Implant Surgical Kit (A Simplified Minimally Invasive Technique): A Case Series
pmc-12634315.creator: Mehdi Ekhlasmandkermani, Behzad Houshmand, Emir Ilkerli, Fatemeh Goudarzimoghaddam
pmc-12634315.description: Here, we present two Persian 58‐ and 39‐year‐old females with an edentulous posterior maxilla in the first molar region and a minimum residual bone height (RBH) of 4 mm. Sinus floor elevation with crestal approach was considered. Platelet‐rich fibrin (PRF) was utilized as a crucial safeguard during sinus floor elevation with the assistance of bone tap drills featuring round ends.

pmc-12753531.title: A Current Approach to Logistic Regression Analysis of Birth Order and Sexual Orientation
pmc-12753531.creator: Ray Blanchard, Jan Kabátek, Bozena Zdaniuk
pmc-12753531.description: Numerous statistical procedures have been developed to examine the statistical relations between quantifiable aspects of an individual’s sibship and the likelihood of that individual manifesting a homosexual preference. Our purpose in this methodological paper is explaining how to use and how to interpret the multiple regression approach introduced by Ablaza et al.

pmc-12785064.title: Total Quadriceps Resection in High-Grade Soft-Tissue Sarcomas of the Thigh: Surgical Technique and Long-Term Functional Outcomes in Surviving Patients
pmc-12785064.creator: Luis Rafael Ramos Pascua, Paula Casas Ramos, Rubén Álvarez García, Sergio Sánchez Herráez, Cristina Ojeda Thies, Maximiliano Eugenio Negri, Daniel Bustamante Recuenco, Jesús Enrique Vilá Rico
pmc-12785064.description: Simple SummaryOne challenge of compartmental resection of soft-tissue sarcomas of the anterior thigh is the disruption of the quadriceps extensor mechanism. The authors present their results in 10 patients followed postoperatively for a minimum of 4 years in the 5 surviving patients who underwent conservative surgical procedures and discuss their surgical technique to reestablish extensor function of the knee.

pmc-12824239.title: Splenectomy reduces shear stress and inflammation in liver endothelial cells during regeneration after partial hepatectomy in mice
pmc-12824239.creator: Andrey Elchaninov, Elena Gantsova, Polina Vishnyakova, Maria Kuznetsova, Dmitry Trofimov, Timur Fatkhudinov, Gennady Sukhikh
pmc-12824239.description: Clinical and experimental findings indicate that splenectomy stimulates liver regeneration. The mechanisms of this effect are uncertain. This study aimed to assess the effect of splenectomy on the state of sinusoidal endothelial cells during liver regeneration after 70% resection in mouse model. Two series of experiments were performed.

pmc-12940601.title: Seasonal changes in 3D space use and foraging strategies in the avivorous bat Ia io
pmc-12940601.creator: Zhi-Qiang Wang, Li-Xin Gong, Man Si, Zheng-Lanyi Huang, Hui Wu, Jiang Feng, Ting-Lei Jiang
pmc-12940601.description: To cope with seasonal changes in food availability, animals need to optimize their behaviors, including shifts in temporal activity patterns and spatial use in habitats. Most studies focused on the temporal activity pattern or habitat use in two-dimensional (2D) space. However, studies on the simultaneous changes in temporal activity patterns and habitat use in three-dimensional (3D) space are limited.

pmc-13083941.title: The INGV data registry as a curated metadata infrastructure for Earth Science data stewardship
pmc-13083941.creator: Mario Locati, Salvatore Mazza, Placido Montalto, Vincenzo Romano, Valentino Lauciani, Roberto Vallone, Stefano Cacciaguerra
pmc-13083941.description: The Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia (INGV), Italy’s primary institution for geophysics and volcanology, produces vast, heterogeneous geophysical and volcanological datasets. To enhance these assets under Open Science mandates, we implemented the INGV Data Registry: a centralized, curated metadata infrastructure.

pmc-13146314.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1048 POST-THROMBOLYSIS LIPOPROTEIN(A) AND THE RISK OF SYMPTOMATIC HEMORRHAGIC TRANSFORMATION IN ACUTE ISCHEMIC STROKE
pmc-13146314.creator: Mi Sun Oh, Byung-Chul Lee, Chaery Jeon
pmc-13146314.description: Background and aimsLipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] is a proatherogenic and prothrombotic biomarker, but its association with hemorrhagic transformation (HT) after intravenous thrombolysis with recombinant tissue plasminogen activator (IV tPA) in acute ischemic stroke (AIS) remains unclear. We investigated whether Lp(a) levels are associated with symptomatic HT.MethodsThis retrospective single-center study included 336 consecutive AIS patients treated with IV tPA between 2020 and 2025.

pmc-13177866.title: Addressing priority gaps in access and quality of NCD services in primary care settings in Rural Kenya: a participatory approach to intervention development
pmc-13177866.creator: Ogol Japheth Ouma, Dickens Omondi, Elijah Museve, Ivy Akinyi, Nichodemus Were Amollo, Sylvester Ogutu, Elizabeth Obinge, Jane Owenga, George Ayodo, Johannes Bogers, Josefien van Olmen
pmc-13177866.description: BackgroundNon-communicable diseases (NCDs), particularly diabetes mellitus (DM) and hypertension (HTN), are projected to surpass communicable diseases as the leading causes of mortality in Africa by 2030. Kenya remains off track to achieving the 25 × 25 global targets for reducing premature NCD mortality, underscoring the need to strengthen prevention, early detection, and management at the primary healthcare (PHC) level.

pmc-13228104.title: Promoting Mental Well-being in Iranian Children: Assessing the Impact of a Philosophy for Children Program Through Behavioral Evaluation
pmc-13228104.creator: Fatemeh Vosoughian, Fariba Khodagholi, Arman Zeinaddini-Meymand, Maryam Alsadat Mousavi, Roohollah Karimi, Taravat Rasooli, Fereshteh Khodagholi, Yahya Ghaedi, Saba Amiri
pmc-13228104.description: Introduction:Given today’s intricate individual and societal demands, conventional educational strategies may not adequately meet essential needs. Consequently, alternative methodologies, such as ‘philosophy for children’ (P4C), have gained traction. In Iran, P4C has been implemented in the education of young children over the past decade, with a distinct focus on enhancing reasoning and critical thinking skills.

pmc-13256260.title: Pleiotropic shared heritability quantifies the shared genetic variance of common diseases
pmc-13256260.creator: Yujie Zhao, Benjamin Strober, Kangcheng Hou, Gaspard Kerner, John Danesh, Steven Gazal, Wei Cheng, Michael Inouye, Alkes L. Price, Xilin Jiang
pmc-13256260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The overall contribution of pleiotropy to disease architectures is unknown, as most studies estimate genetic correlations with each auxiliary disease in turn. pmc-13315763.creator: Elena Ammendola, Giulia Paparella, Emmanuella Ladisa, Giusy Tancredi, Giulia Paparella, Grazia Devigili, Marianna Diletta Delussi, Katia Ricci, Livio Clemente, Marina de Tommaso
pmc-13315763.description: Objective: Fibromyalgia (FM) is a chronic disease characterised by small fibre pathology and autonomic dysfunction. Sympathetic Skin Response (SSR) can be easily obtained in clinical practice as a marker of autonomic dysfunction. This study aims to assess SSR abnormalities in small fibre pathology associated with FM.

pmc-13414310.title: Metabolomic Profiling Has the Potential to Differentiate Between Iron Deficiency Anemia and Anemia of Inflammation
pmc-13414310.creator: Triin Paabo, Eliis Grigor, Egon Taalberg, Natalja Luppova, Eliise-Rosalinda Raudmäe, Piret Mihkelson, Alan Altraja, Ain Kaare, Rando Porosk, Kalle Kilk
pmc-13414310.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Anemia is associated with metabolomic alterations of polyunsaturated fatty acid metabolism.Metabolomic profiling could distinguish anemia subtypes. What are the implications of the main findings? The preliminary results need validation in larger cohorts, but metabolomics may contribute to the classification of anemia subtypes not adequately distinguished by existing biomarkers.

pmc-13468519.creator: Zelin Liu, Haiqing Yang, Jiawei Cui, Zhengkun Guan, Duo Gao, Pingyong Feng, He Yang, Wenyi Li, Yuanhui Zhao, Qianhang Yang, Xuyang Zheng, Qi Liu, Zuojun Geng

pmc-13592892.description: Background:Ulcerative colitis is an autoimmune disease with an unfamiliar etiology, which caused by environmental, microbial, and genetic factors. Harpagophytum procumbens (H. procumbens, Devil’s Claw), could be effective in the treatment of colitis due to its strong anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and restorative effects. Therefore, this research aimed to explore this property.Methods:The hydroalcoholic extract of H.

pmc-13651218.title: Nutritional and physiological severity scores for predicting 30-day mortality in geriatric intensive care unit patients: a multicenter prospective study
pmc-13651218.creator: Muhammed Mert Can, Akkan Avci, Saliha Dilek Oztoprak Hacioglu, Ahmet Burak Urfalioglu, Erdem Aksay, Yeliz Simsek, Sadiye Yolcu Seven, Begum Seyda Avci, Ali Ayvaz, Ecem Basak Kaya, Aysegul Sancaktar, Adnan Kuvvetli, Yusuf Yurumez, Furkan Bostanci, Ozgur Sogut, Adem Az, Muhammed Ikbal Sasmaz, Cemil Yi
pmc-13651218.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to assess nutritional risk in older adults admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) from the emergency department (ED) and to examine its relationship with 30-day mortality by comparing nutritional assessment tools with physiological severity scores.MethodThe study was conducted simultaneously across 20 EDs.
